source: FY2027 DPWH in-depth data snapshot and read-only Senate POW title scan
matchMethod: Read-only first-page native-text title scan. Relaxed candidates require token recall >= 0.72, precision >= 0.78, Dice overlap >= 0.74, a shared specific token, matching numeric tokens when present, and a 0.05 lead over the runner-up. Rough estimate, not manually verified.
scopeNote: The parser and title scanner have different denominators. A title match means at least one scanned Senate POW was linked to an HGAB-only row; this does not verify document contents or prove the project scope. The first-page scanner found no native text on 850 files and recorded 2 scan errors.
parserSource: Current published DPWH in-depth data and parsed Senate HGAB POW result shards
